EU–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (in force 1 February 2019)
EU–Canada Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (provisionally applied since 21 September 2017)
All other bilateral investment treaties of the French Republic currently in force, applied by reference to the home jurisdiction of each identified ultimate beneficial owner

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 et seq. and R.561-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843; Article L.561-45 of the Code monétaire et financier establishing the beneficial ownership register; Ordonnance n° 2016-1635 of 1 December 2016; Décret n° 2017-1094 of 27 June 2017; Articles R.123-55 et seq. and R.561-55 et seq. of the French Commercial Code; ACPR and TRACFIN guidance on AML/CFT duties of obliged entities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft articles of association (statuts) of the French SARL, signed by all shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French notaire where notarization is obligatory; otherwise the shareholders and their counsel in the place of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization where executed outside France, followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of valid passports or national identity documents of every manager and every ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport, identity, or civil registry authority of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for documents originating outside France, followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address for each manager and ultimate beneficial owner, dated within the immediately preceding three months
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Municipal authority, utility provider, or recognized financial institution in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization if required by the issuing state, followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance certificate / criminal record extract for the proposed statutory manager (gérant), where the manager is not a French resident
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Justice or national criminal records authority of the manager's country of residence; for French residents, the Service du casier judiciaire national
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the incorporation agent or legal counsel, if the shareholders do not sign personally
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary, court, or competent authority in the jurisdiction where the power of attorney is executed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank or escrow reference letter evidencing source of funds for the initial capitalization of the SARL
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank, escrow institution, or other regulated financial institution holding the funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or Consular Legalization where required by the issuing institution's jurisdiction, followed by sworn French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons under Articles L.561-10 and L.561-10-2 of the Code monétaire et financier. The SARL and its intermediaries must screen all managers, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners against the French Ministry of the Economy asset-freeze list, EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, UN Security Council sanctions, and TRACFIN/ACPR supervisory guidance. OFAC SDN screening is additionally performed where any UBO, counterparty, lender, or payment route has a US-nexus or where USD clearing may be used, to mitigate correspondent-bank and maritime trade compliance risk. The UBO analysis must pierce all legal layers until a natural person who controls or owns more than 25% of the capital or voting rights is identified.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises, operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); Registre National des Entreprises (RNE); Infogreffe for Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés extracts and name-based searches.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The dénomination sociale must be expressed in Latin script and supported by French-language articles of association. All official statutory filings and legal publications must be in French. A non-French name or term may be used only if accompanied by a clear French transliteration or translation where necessary, and it must not be contrary to public order, misleading as to the company's object, or identical or confusingly similar to a name already protected in France.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'Banque' — banking term requiring ACPR authorization or prohibited if misleading
'France', 'République', 'Nationale' — national-entity terms subject to reservation or strict conditions
'Officiel', 'Gouvernement', 'Union européenne', 'Nations Unies' — terms suggesting official status or public authority
'Notaire', 'Avocat', 'Auditeur' — regulated professional titles restricted to qualified practitioners
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French law does not provide a standalone statutory name-reservation certificate for SARLs; name availability is verified in the course of the incorporation filing. If the name is rejected, the applicant receives a reasoned decision through the Guichet Unique/INPI. The applicant may: (1) file an internal rectification or reconsideration request with INPI within 15 days of notification; (2) amend the name and submit a new incorporation filing; or (3) bring a judicial appeal before the competent tribunal judiciaire or tribunal de commerce within one month of the refusal, in accordance with the Code de commerce and Code de procédure civile. A pre-emptive French trademark filing at INPI, once registered, gives enforceable name protection in renewable ten-year terms, but it does not extend the administrative name-verification window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for the administrative and legal seat of a French SARL through a licensed domiciliation company, but a virtual office alone is not sufficient commercial substance for a shipyard engaged in the construction of deep-sea dry cargo and container vessels. A physical production facility, environmental and industrial permits, and maritime-related registrations must be declared and maintained.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: 70–85% likelihood of at least one unannounced on-site inspection within the first 24 months of operation by labour inspectorate, environmental authorities, customs, fire-safety authorities, or maritime regulatory bodies.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory search fee plus prevailing market professional fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of French SARL articles of association, shareholder agreements, and bilingual English/French legal documentation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark on a fixed or hourly professional fee basis; no fixed statutory tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille/consular legalization, and sworn French translation of foreign UBO documents, powers of attorney, and identity documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial, consular, and translation fee schedules

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation and filing of the declaration of beneficial owners (Déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs) with the company registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce; INPI/Guichet Unique

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the notice of incorporation (avis de constitution) in a legal gazette approved by the Prefecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales approved by the Prefecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutorily capped tariff for mandatory legal advertisements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing of the complete incorporation dossier and registration of the SARL in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce; INPI/Guichet Unique
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry fee schedule for incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC, PEP, sanctions, and OFAC screening of all managers, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML compliance data provider; AML/CFT legal advisor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market subscription and per-file due diligence rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation agreement with a licensed domiciliation company for the initial 12-month term

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market lease or domiciliation service contract

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for pre-incorporation regulatory due diligence

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code), Articles L. 223-1 to L. 227-10 (Sociétés à responsabilité limitée)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte de constitution et statuts de la société
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed capital of 1 EUR; no escrow account required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Articles of Association of the Company are adopted, establishing it as a French SARL with a minimum capital of 1 EUR. The corporate purpose is the construction and repair of ocean container vessels and deep-sea dry cargo ships. RESOLVED that the registered office is set at [full address], France. RESOLVED that [Name1] is appointed Chairman of the Board and [Name2] as Managing Director, with full powers of representation and management. RESOLVED that the initial shareholder subscribes the entire capital. This resolution is passed unanimously by the Board of Directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public and Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts including company name, purpose (shipbuilding), capital, directors. Notarize at a notary. Prepare power of attorney if foreign shareholder.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit corrections within 8 days if queried by registry

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via online portal or in person
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the acte de constitution and statuts to the greffe. Pay filing fees. Obtain Kbis extract after publication.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de la Transition écologique et de la Cohésion des territoires

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per EU Water Framework Directive, VOC emissions < 20 mg/Nm³, hazardous waste disposal compliant with REACH

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from SDIS (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours), structural safety inspections, and compliance with occupational health and safety regulations under the Labour Code

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal https://www.impots.gouv.fr/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French resident entities obtain SIREN/SIRET automatically through the guichet unique; foreign entities register via guichet unique to obtain TIN and VAT identification number if applicable based on activity and turnover.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box; subject to French entity-level taxation with hybrid mismatch provisions under the Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD)

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing through the Portail de Facturation Électronique (PEP) for all VAT-registered entities; real-time data reporting and digital fiscal stamps required for clearance and audit purposes

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods exported outside the European Union or services supplied to non-EU recipients; eligibility requires proof of export and non-EU destination
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Administrative penalties of 40% of the evaded VAT plus interest; full clawback of zero-rating benefits and potential criminal sanctions for fraudulent claims

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) acting with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) under the monetary and financial code; no separate foreign exchange administration exists in France
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Capital and current account convertibility are unrestricted under Article 63 TFEU and the eurozone framework. France imposes no exchange-control authorization on ordinary trade transactions, profit repatriation, or non-sensitive equity/loan injections. The practical hurdles are documentary and administrative: balance-of-payments reporting by resident banks, EU sanctions/AML screening, foreign investment screening for sensitive sectors, and tax compliance for dividend distributions. A SARL may declare and pay dividends to non-resident shareholders after approval of audited annual accounts; withholding tax at domestic or treaty rate applies unless the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or an applicable double tax treaty reduces it. No convertibility restriction blocks remittance of profits in EUR or foreign currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or conversion obligation exists. Export receipts may be retained in EUR or foreign exchange indefinitely without a mandatory conversion ratio or time limit. Resident exporters may hold foreign-currency bank accounts in France; banks report transactions for balance-of-payments statistics. Physical cash carried over EUR 10,000 must be declared to customs under EU cash control rules, and underlying export documentation must be retained for at least six years.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank (CA-CIB)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for secondary disbursements and low for core escrow/LC functions. Fintech EMIs are not credit institutions; they cannot offer true capital escrow accounts, maritime installment letters of credit, or advance payment bank guarantees. An EEA fintech EMI holding an ACPR passport may open a payment account and process SWIFT/SEPA transfers, but the French shipyard's treasury backbone must remain at a licensed credit institution. Legal constraints include the French Monetary and Financial Code, EMI-specific activity limitations, inability to extend credit or provide bank guarantees, and enhanced reputational risk in the medium-risk shipbuilding sector.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law permits remote customer due diligence using certified electronic identification or video verification, but most tier-1 banks require in-person appearance or notarial/legalized powers of attorney for complex SARL structures. For a SARL with non-resident shareholders, the gérant (manager) and directors named as authorized signatories are generally required to attend a physical KYC interview or a notarized electronic signing session. Remote opening is possible only where the corporate structure is transparent, all UBOs are identifiable, the bank accepts a dual-custody video call, and digital identity verification satisfies ANSSI-certified standards.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership with opaque corporate chain or nominee shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized certificate of incorporation and bylaws in French/English; fully annotated cap table with all UBOs above 10%; passports and proof of residence of each UBO; bank reference letters; source-of-wealth declaration; certified resolutions appointing the gérant; shareholder register (registre des associés); and a letter confirming beneficial ownership of the SARL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shipyard industry exposure triggering enhanced due diligence and sanctions screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial classification certificate evidencing non-military ocean container vessel construction; ISIC/NAICS scope confirmation; export control and dual-use clearance from the Amiral trade control bureau; builder's certificate and customer end-use statement; compliance manual demonstrating EU restrictive measures screening; and a legal opinion confirming the vessel is civilian.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large advance payments from non-EU charterers or buyers under Maritime Installment LC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed shipbuilding contract with installment schedule; purchase order and proforma invoices; inspection certificates for each construction stage; bank guarantee/advance payment bond documentation; transport and delivery milestones under Incoterms; and sworn declarations of the ultimate buyer and financing source.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk source of funds for the initial capital injection from third-country shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate resolutions and board minutes; SWIFT transfer records showing the direct remittance trail; source-of-funds affidavit with bank statements; audited financial statements of the shareholder; tax identification and residence certificates; underlying loan agreement or share subscription agreement; and a certified copy of the capital contribution declared at the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be made by SWIFT MT103 or SEPA credit transfer to the SARL's operational or escrow account at the selected French bank. The remittance must clearly state the corporate beneficiary, the purpose code in the payment message, and an explicit description in field 70 such as 'INVESTISSEMENT DIRECT – APPORTS EN CAPITAL' for equity or 'NANTISSEMENT DE COMPTE – PRÊT ACTIONNAIRE' for shareholder loans. The French bank will verify the UBO structure, screen sanctions lists, request the share subscription agreement or promissory note, and report the transaction to Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistics. No prior exchange-control authorization is required for non-sensitive sectors; however, French foreign investment screening may apply if the shipyard qualifies as a protected sector, in which case prior notification or authorization to the Direction Générale du Trésor must be completed. Escrow accounts must be opened with a domestic credit institution to be recognized for capital release and shareholder protection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for shipbuilding materials, equipment, and subcontractors should be executed through SWIFT MT103 for non-EEA suppliers, SEPA credit transfers for EUR payments within the EEA, and commercial documentary letters of credit for maritime installment disbursements to overseas buyers or importers. A Marino Installment LC must be issued by the French issuing bank and advised/confirmed by the foreign bank, with presentation documents comprising commercial invoices, packing lists, customs declarations, inspection certificates, and the vessel construction milestone certificate. Each disbursement requires matching the underlying contract schedule, Incoterms obligations, and transferable advance payment guarantee arrangements. For outbound supplier payments, the remittance message must include the export-import customs reference, invoice number, and trade purpose code; the bank will apply sanctions screening and may require supporting contracts to release funds.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forward contracts (marché de change à terme)
EUR/USD and EUR/GBP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) where the underlying exposure is in a non-convertible currency and the counterparty is an eligible bank
Cross-currency swaps between EUR and USD and EUR and GBP
Plain vanilla bought FX options with non-bank counterparties or OTC options with regulated banks
Vanilla FX swaps for working capital liquidity matching
Interest rate and cross-currency swaps combined with shipyard financing cash-flow hedges

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (Comptes annuels) and management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of the Commercial Court (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of fiscal year-end for shareholder approval and filing within 1 month of approval (absolute deadline: 7 months post year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of EUR 5 per day (capped at EUR 150); court-imposed penalties; persistent non-filing triggers administrative strike-off and personal liability of managers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Liasse fiscale) including balance sheet, profit and loss, and supporting schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Electronic filing by 3rd month after fiscal year-end (calendar-year companies: 30 April)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty equal to 5% of tax due (10% if after 30 days) plus monthly late interest of 0.2% per month; enforceable administrative collections.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local economic contribution (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises - CFE) return and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Return due 3 June; payment due 15 September
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 10% plus interest of 6% if unpaid by 31 December; coercive distraint or asset seizure possible.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership annual review and update (Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of the Commercial Court (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing at incorporation and within 30 days of any change; annual verification performed during the statutory accounts approval cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or false declaration subject to fine of up to EUR 10,000 and other civil/criminal sanctions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory independent audit is required when any two of the three following thresholds are exceeded: total assets EUR 4,500,000; net turnover EUR 9,000,000; average workforce of 50 employees. Commercial shipyards of this scale typically exceed all three.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French local GAAP (Plan Comptable Général – PCG) as the primary statutory framework; consolidated financial statements must follow EU-endorsed IFRS when the entity forms part of a consolidated group.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a separate annual UBO republication. Instead, the SARL must keep the register of beneficial owners fully current and must file any amendment with the Commercial Registry within 30 days of a share transfer or other change. The annual corporate maintenance process includes a compulsory review of the UBO register during the internal accounts approval, ensuring that all share transfers are correctly recorded and, where necessary, an updated UBO declaration is filed within 30 days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Decisions (Registre des décisions)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax (IS) for fiscal years closed since 1 January 2022; reduced 15% rate applies to the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs with turnover below EUR 10 million, subject to conditions.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic shipyard-specific tax holiday. Relevant incentives include: Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% of qualifying R&D expenditure up to EUR 100 million and 5% above; Innovation Tax Credit for SMEs; Young Innovative Enterprise (JEI) regime for eligible research-intensive companies; tax credit for employee training; accelerated depreciation for certain environmental and energy-transition equipment. EU state-aid compatibility limits any direct shipbuilding subsidy.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward under French law, subject to an annual statutory cap of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable income exceeding EUR 1,000,000; optional one-year carryback capped at EUR 1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 2065-SD (CERFA 15978) together with annexes 2050 through 2059; filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr using the EFI/EDI professional module (TéléTVA).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; separate quarterly advance instalments are due for corporate income tax.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending on 31 December, return and final payment are due by the second business day after 1 May of the following year. For a non-calendar-year fiscal year, the deadline is within three months after the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre A - Identification and APE code
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal form SARL, company name, SIREN/SIRET, registered office, APE code 3011Z for shipbuilding and repair, fiscal year opening and closing dates, and legal representative details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the French tax representative or French-appointed manager. Non-resident beneficial owners are not entered in this field; their identity is declared through separate beneficial-owner reporting obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting profit or loss before tax derived from French statutory accounts under Plan Comptable Général, including shipyard revenue from ocean container vessel construction, progress billings under long-term maritime contracts, and provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use French GAAP as it applies to the French entity; do not substitute the non-resident parent's local GAAP or IFRS figures without a reconciliation attachment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable result after recalculating non-deductible charges, excessive depreciation, non-arm's length intra-group expenses, provisions, and exempt income, including long-term capital gains eligible for deferral.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure cross-border payments to related parties are supported by transfer pricing analysis. The non-resident owner should not request allocation of French profits abroad absent a genuine permanent-establishment arrangement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward from previous years and offset against the current taxable result within the statutory annual limit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses incurred by the French SARL itself are reportable. Losses of a non-resident parent or foreign permanent establishment are not deductible at French head-office level unless a treaty credit mechanism applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Ligne YI - Réductions et crédits d'impôt
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits and reductions, including Research Tax Credit (CIR), Innovation Tax Credit, apprenticeship tax credit, and other imputable credits for French shipyard operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned SARL may claim CIR only if it performs the research in France and is subject to French CIT; the credit cannot be repatriated free of dividend tax if later distributed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre E - Liquidation de l'impôt sur les sociétés
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of final corporate income tax due: application of 25% standard rate, 15% reduced SME bracket, offset of advance payments, and net balance payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No group consolidation with foreign parent. The French subsidiary is taxed separately; rate relief is determined by the French entity's own turnover and ownership structure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a statutory majoration of 10% of the net tax due; late payment interest accrues at 0.20% per month. Failure to file after formal notice can increase the majoration to 40%, and concealed taxable activity can attract an 80% penalty. Additional fines apply for missing schedules and electronic filing failures.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% as the domestic withholding tax on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders. The 25% rate is reduced or eliminated under applicable double tax treaties and, within the EU, under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive where the parent holds a qualifying participation of at least 5% for at least two years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke treaty relief, the non-resident beneficial owner must submit a current certificate of tax residence (TRC) to the French paying agent, usually accompanied by French Form 5000 or the relevant OECD model residence statement, before the dividend payment date. If the reduced rate cannot be applied at source, the non-resident must file Form RF 1921 with the non-resident tax service to claim a refund of the excess withholding. Treaty relief is denied where the recipient lacks beneficial ownership or where the Principal Purpose Test is failed.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and licence fees paid to non-residents for rights exploited in France are subject to a statutory withholding tax of 25%, subject to treaty reductions often to 0%, 5%, or 10%. Interest paid by a French borrower to a non-resident lender is generally exempt from French withholding tax where the lender is the true arm's length creditor, but a punitive 75% withholding rate may apply to payments to entities established in non-cooperative jurisdictions absent valid substance and treaty benefits.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File apply where the French entity or group exceeds the EU SME exemption thresholds: more than 250 employees and either annual turnover above EUR 50 million or balance-sheet total above EUR 43 million. Country-by-Country reporting applies to groups with consolidated turnover of at least EUR 750 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not apply a GCC-style Economic Substance Regulations regime. Ordinary French corporate residence relies on effective management and core commercial activities in France. Substance is nevertheless indispensable for treaty benefits under the beneficial-owner test, the OECD Principal Purpose Test, and the French general anti-abuse rule. A shipyard SARL without genuine staff, physical yard, risk management, and commercial decision-making in France will be challenged as a conduit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately concealing shipyard turnover, reporting fake subcontractor invoices, destroying accounting records, or under-declaring statutory profits of the French SARL.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 1741 of the French Tax Code, tax fraud is punishable by imprisonment of up to five years and a fine of EUR 250,000, with increases to seven years and EUR 500,000 in aggravating circumstances. Administrative penalties include a 40% bad-faith majoration or 80% penalty for concealment, plus late-payment interest at 0.20% per month.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who personally participate in or authorise fraudulent filings face criminal conviction, disqualification from management up to five years, publication of the judgment, and civil liability for the State's lost tax revenue. Corporate veil protection does not shield deliberate fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling ocean container vessels or shipyard services to foreign related entities at artificial discounts, overpaying non-resident group service fees, or shifting royalties and interest to low-tax jurisdictions without arm's length economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax reassessment with interest, 40% bad-faith majoration generally, 80% for abuse of law, and refusal to deduct expenses paid to non-cooperative jurisdictions. Incomplete transfer pricing documentation attracts autonomous penalties and a 5% penalty on any reassessment attributable to missing documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly and severally for penalties where they signed false returns or knowingly organised artificial transfer pricing structures. Criminal tax fraud charges can attach to cross-border profit stripping schemes and trigger travel bans and asset confiscation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the French SARL as a hollow invoice conduit for foreign shipowners, keeping no employees or yard facilities, and using French treaty laws without real commercial activity in France.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The French administrative anti-abuse rule (Art. L64 of the Livre des Procédures Fiscales) allows recharacterisation of the entire arrangement; abusive schemes are subject to penalty of up to 80% plus interest. Treaty or EU Parent-Subsidiary relief is denied for lack of beneficial ownership and substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a sham company may be personally liable for the corporate tax obligations under faute de gestion. In insolvency, the court may impose comblement de passif, forcing directors to restore the company's liabilities. Criminal money laundering charges may follow where the conduit is used for fraudulent transfers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting vessel construction payments from sanctioned persons or shell companies, splitting large maritime payments through escrow accounts to avoid AML thresholds, or submitting false export and end-user documents for military-capable container vessel systems.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the French Monetary and Financial Code, aggravated money laundering is punishable by ten years' imprisonment and a fine of EUR 750,000. Violations of financial and trade embargoes may trigger seven years' imprisonment and EUR 350,000 fines. The vessel, corporate assets, and accounts are subject to confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally exposed to criminal prosecution for inadequately monitoring beneficial ownership or knowingly processing prohibited funds. Personal asset forfeiture, travel bans, and disqualification from corporate office can be imposed. D&O insurance typically excludes intentional criminal conduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file Form 2065-SD or annexes, failing to pay quarterly instalments, deliberately omitting schedules for tax credits, or refusing production of transfer pricing files on tax inspection.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late filing majoration of 10%, increased to 40% after formal notice and 80% for hidden activity; late-payment interest of 0.20% per month; enforced recovery by avis de mise en recouvrement, bank seizure, and sale of corporate assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives who fail to pay corporate tax while orchestrating insolvency can be made personally liable by the commercial court. The manager may also face a travel ban, prohibition on managing a business, and civil liability for the resulting fiscal debt.
